append-to-body.description: Controls should Drawer be inserted to DocumentBody Element, nested Drawer must assign this param to true
append-to-body.description_zh: Drawer 自身是否插入至 body 元素上。嵌套的 Drawer 必须指定该属性并赋值为 true

append-to.description: which element the Drawer appends to. Will override `append-to-body`
append-to.description_zh: Drawer 挂载到哪个 DOM 元素

lock-scroll.description: whether scroll of body is disabled while Drawer is displayed
lock-scroll.description_zh: 是否在 Drawer 出现时将 body 滚动锁定

:before-close.description: If set, closing procedure will be halted
:before-close.description_zh: 关闭前的回调，会暂停 Drawer 的关闭

close-on-click-modal.description: whether the Drawer can be closed by clicking the mask
close-on-click-modal.description_zh: 是否可以通过点击 modal 关闭 Drawer

close-on-press-escape.description: Indicates whether Drawer can be closed by pressing ESC
close-on-press-escape.description_zh: 是否可以通过按下 ESC 关闭 Drawer

:open-delay.description_zh: Drawer 打开的延时时间，单位毫秒

:close-delay.description_zh: Drawer 关闭的延时时间，单位毫秒

destroy-on-close.description: Indicates whether children should be destroyed after Drawer closed
destroy-on-close.description_zh: 控制是否在关闭 Drawer 之后将子元素全部销毁

show-close.description: Should show close button at the top right of Drawer

size.description: Drawer's size, if Drawer is horizontal mode, it effects the width property, otherwise it effects the height property, when size is `number` type, it describes the size by unit of pixels; when size is `string` type, it should be used with `x%` notation, other wise it will be interpreted to pixel unit
size.description_zh: Drawer 窗体的大小, 当使用 `number` 类型时, 以像素为单位, 当使用 `string` 类型时, 请传入 'x%', 否则便会以 `number` 类型解释

title.description: Drawer's title, can also be set by named slot, detailed descriptions can be found in the slot form
title.description_zh: Drawer 的标题，也可通过具名 slot 传入

withHeader.description: Flag that controls the header section's existance, default to true, when withHeader set to false, both `title attribute` and `title slot` won't work
withHeader.description_zh: 控制是否显示 header 栏, 默认为 true, 当此项为 false 时, title attribute 和 title slot 均不生效

modal-class.description: Extra class names for shadowing layer

header-class.description: custom class names for header wrapper
header-class.description_zh: header 包装器的自定义类名

body-class.description: custom class names for body wrapper
body-class.description_zh: body 包装器的自定义类名

footer-class.description: custom class names for footer wrapper
footer-class.description_zh: footer 包装器的自定义类名

events.name: open
events.description: Triggered before Drawer opening animation begins

events.name: opened
events.description: Triggered after Drawer opening animation ended
events.description_zh: Drawer 打开动画结束时的回调

events.name: close
events.description: Triggered before Drawer closing animation begins

events.name: closed
events.description: Triggered after Drawer closing animation ended
events.description_zh: Drawer 关闭动画结束时的回调

events.name: open-auto-focus
events.description: triggers after Drawer opens and content focused
events.description_zh: 输入焦点聚焦在 Drawer 内容时的回调

events.name: close-auto-focus
events.description: triggers after Drawer closed and content focused
events.description_zh: 输入焦点从 Drawer 内容失焦时的回调

slots.name: header
slots.description: Drawer header section; Replacing this removes the title, but does not remove the close button.
slots.description_zh: Drawer 标题的内容；会替换标题部分，但不会移除关闭按钮

slots.name: title
slots.description: Works the same as the header slot. Use that instead.
slots.description_zh: 与 header 插槽功能相同，请使用 header 插槽

exposed.name: handleClose
exposed.description: In order to close Drawer, this method will call `before-close`.
exposed.description_zh: 关闭 Drawer，此方法会调用 `before-close`
